title: Systems Administrator
description:
Join the Digital Transformation Journey at NDB!
The National Development Bank is undergoing a major digital transformation to modernize its banking systems, enhance customer experience, and strengthen operational efficiency. We are seeking a skilled and proactive Systems Administrator to support this exciting transition and ensure the reliability, security, and performance of our ICT infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage servers, including e-mail, print, and backup servers and their associated operations systems and software
Manage security solutions, including firewalls, anti-virus, and intrusion detection systems
Oversee installation, configurations, maintenance, and troubleshooting of end user, software, and peripheral devices
Administer all software upgrades
Perform conceptual systems design and capacity planning
Conduct research on services, protocols, and standards in support of systems procurement and development efforts
Interact and negotiate with vendors, outsources, and contractors to ensure systems products and services
Develop, implement and maintain policies, procedures and associated training plans for systems resource administration, appropriate use, and disaster recovery
Establish services level agreements with end users
Administer and maintain end user accounts, permissions, and access rights
Perform server and security audits
Perform system backup and recovery
Monitor and test systems performance and provide network performance statistics and reports
Recommend, schedule, and perform systems improvements, upgrades, and repairs
Manage and/or provide guidance to junior members of the team
Qualifications & Experience
College or university degree in the field of computer since and/or 3 years equivalent work experience.
Certifications in Systems Administrations (MCSE, MCSA)
Working technical knowledge of network and PC operating systems, including servers.
Extensive application support experience
Good understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives
Strong written and oral communications skills
Strong interpersonal skills
Ability to present ideas in user-friendly language
Highly self-motivated and directed
Keen attention to detail
Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment
Strong customer service orientation
Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
